note: PROPSWAY v1 (fk_propsway, read by Scripts/PropSway.cs, hot reloaded by write time every ~5 s through MatAdjustRuntime.Scan). mode off (shipped) or no file = nothing moves and every prop is put back exactly. mode on = rows. Rigid sway of BAKED prop wrappers picked by GameObject name (ordinal, ignore case; exclude = skip words; zone = part of the scene root name; zMin/zMax = world z band). kind chain = swing about the top of the renderer bounds perpendicular to the wind, tip downwind, lagged; cloth = yaw twist about the pole axis; branch = lean about the base. maxDeg = peak angle, periodS = main period (second period 0.41x, 28 percent), lagS = first order lag, windGain 0 = amplitude ignores the Wind field, 1 = proportional to |Wind.Vec|/refSpeedMps (wind.json), phase and period +-periodJitter come from a hash of the name. Only items within rangeM of the camera, at most maxMovers, nearest first. Items in a static batch or under an Animator are skipped. Slow and small by design: nothing pulses or bounces. Judge from a motion strip, not a still.
